about_the_game:
Slide. Merge. Conquer the grid.
Number Merge Mania is a clean, clever puzzle game that challenges your logic and spatial thinking. Move numbered blocks across the board, but every block has a limited number of moves. Once it stops, it locks in place. Your goal? Fill every tile in the grid using smart strategy, careful planning, and sharp foresight.

Features

  • Limited-move mechanics: each block travels only as far as its allowed steps

  • Grid-filling challenge: you must occupy every empty cell to solve a level

  • Progressive difficulty: puzzles start simple and become increasingly complex

  • Minimalist visuals: clean, uncluttered design so gameplay stands out

  • Casual for all: easy to pick up but deep enough to hook puzzle fans

  • Singleplayer brain game that rewards logic and forethought

About This Game

In Number Merge Mania, you’re presented with a grid and several numbered blocks. Each block can slide in a chosen direction—up, down, left, or right—but only for a limited number of steps. Once it finishes its move, it becomes fixed. You must fill every open cell without leaving gaps.

Because each move is constrained, every decision carries weight. Do you slide a block to open space for future moves? Or lock it in early to free constraints? Missteps can block your path—and force you to restart.

As you progress, levels introduce more complex layouts and constraints, testing your ability to chain thoughtful decisions. Combining visual clarity with mental challenge, Number Merge Mania rewards those who can see multiple steps ahead and adapt under constraints.

This is not a rush-oriented game—you control the pace. Study the grid, test ideas in your head, and execute when ready. Perfect for short breaks or longer puzzle sessions.

Replay levels to refine your finishes, chase flawless completions, and discover new insight into board layouts. No hidden randomness; success comes from your logic and planning.
